TeaShop.Description: Choose from Building, Shed, or false. Building adds the Tea Shop as a new custom building. Shed adds it as a shed upgrade for Market Town compatibility but it will NOT be compatible with other custom shed interiors. False disables the tea shop entirely. Defaults to Building.

InteriorStyle.Description: Choose if you would like the interior of the building to be pre-furnished with movable furniture or empty. Defaults to Furnished. NOTE: you must have the right furniture pack installed in order for the furniture to spawn in. See mod page for details.
